id: Mitigasi ancaman keamanan siber, penanganan insiden, dan asesmen kerentanan sistem.
Konfigurasi system hardening, pengelolaan infrastruktur server, dan implementasi continuous monitoring.
Pengembangan sistem backup server andal dan otomatisasi alur deployment perangkat lunak.
en: Mitigated cybersecurity threats, handled incident response, and performed vulnerability assessments.
Configured system hardening, managed server infrastructure, and deployed continuous monitoring solutions.
Engineered reliable backup systems and assisted in software deployment automation.

id: Asesmen kerentanan menyeluruh, reconnaissance jaringan via Nmap, dan eksploitasi aplikasi web.
Pelaporan temuan celah keamanan secara terstruktur kepada pemangku kepentingan.
Penetrasi situs web, asesmen segmentasi jaringan, dan kolaborasi red team untuk mengeksploitasi kerentanan.
en: Conducted comprehensive vulnerability assessments, network reconnaissance via Nmap, and web application exploitation.
Effectively reported discovered vulnerabilities and remediation paths to key stakeholders.
Performed website penetration testing, network segmentation audits, and collaborated with red teams.
